name: GlyphCascade
description: Character-by-character cryptographic cascade reveal with temporary glyph scrambling, progressive blur reduction, selectable text, and directional sweep control.
a11yNotes: Renders an accessible sr-only text node alongside aria-hidden visual glyph cells while preserving full user text selection once resolved. Skips scrambling under prefers-reduced-motion.

propsApi.name: direction
propsApi.description: Order in which characters lock into their final glyph.

propsApi.name: cascadeStep
propsApi.description: Number of scramble iterations before each character locks.

propsApi.name: blurAmount
propsApi.description: Blur applied to unresolved characters in pixels.
